findings.claim: handoffReport manufactures unverified verdicts: every pin prints 'GREEN at done' with its RED exit code beside it, at any phase, no re-run behind it; RESOLVED findings with vanished evidence still land under WORKED (evidenceOnDisk stubbed true, no missingResolveEvidence); and obligations are computed against an assumed filesystem

Client-authored multi-line text interpolates verbatim into the handoff — a wont-fix justification containing forged section headings renders indistinguishably from the machine's own WORKED/FAILED sections, contradicting the report's no-free-text design claim

The dedup key degrades post-resolve: resolving replaces string evidence with the resolution array, so the resolved finding's key silently falls back to its claim while the candidate keys on evidence — the same escape re-records, exactly the double-spend the feature exists to refuse (the self-test only exercises string-evidence shapes)
batteryOutput is dead wiring — the failing lines are captured and dropped; the refusal carries a static string while the commit message promises 'the failing lines as evidence'

The battery gate diverges from its other statements: obligations()/status calls evaluateTransition without the battery argument (fail-open default true), so status reports 'unblocked' while advance will refuse; the obligations comment's 'one exception' claim is now false; TASK-LIFECYCLE and WIRING do not mention the battery or the handoff command

The battery unit cases pin nothing: the red-battery fixture carries no pin (refused by the pre-existing no-RED-check rule regardless of the flag) and the green case duplicates an existing assertion — deleting the battery check leaves the battery green

The dedup refusal's remedy is unexecutable for closed findings (resolve/wont-fix refuses on non-UNRESOLVED); duplicateEvidenceOf is imported dead into task-state; the claim-keyed stored-side dedup case is untested; the task-state and task-findings banners drift again (28/32 vs 26; the validation/mutation split); the battery's unlocked pre-read inherits the done gate's race shape
findings.justification: The banner derivations landed (task-state and task-findings now derive); the dead import is dropped and the remedy reworded in the repair commit. What remains by design: dedup enforcement lives at the record CLI (the only append transport — the sweep's own analysis says a register appended by other writers is the plain-JSON boundary); the battery's unlocked pre-read inherits the done gate's documented race shape (deliberate: pins/battery may run minutes, holding the file lock through them would gift the stale-breaker a lost update — the narrower race is the recorded trade); the claim-keyed stored-side case is now pinned in task-findings' selfTestDedup.
